verses.1: And the LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with strength I will send them away, and with strength I will drive them out of their land.”
verses.2: And God spoke to Moses, and He said to him, “I am Jehovah.”
verses.3: And I saw Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in Shechem. My name is Jehovah; but I did not know them.
verses.4: And I also made a covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan as their inheritance, the land where they had lived before.
verses.5: And I also heard the cries of the children of Israel who are being enslaved in Egypt. I remember my covenant with them.
verses.6: Therefore, I say to the children of Israel: I, Jehovah, have brought you out from the suffering in Egypt. I have saved you from their oppression. I have redeemed you with great signs and miracles.
verses.7: And I have taken you as my people, and I will be your God. You shall know that I am Jehovah your God, who has brought you out of the bonds of Egypt.
verses.8: And I have brought you into the land that I took by my hand, to give it to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And I will give it to you as a inheritance. I am the LORD.
verses.9: And Moses spoke in this manner to the children of Israel. But they did not listen to Moses, because of their laziness and hard work.
verses.10: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.11: Speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. And send back the children of Israel from their land.
verses.12: And Moses spoke before the LORD and said, “These sons of Israel have not listened to me. How then can Pharaoh listen to me? I am just a man with weak words.”
verses.13: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron. He commanded the children of Israel and Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.14: These are the heads of their families: the sons of Reuben. They lived in the land of Israel. Their homes and vineyards were located there. These are the descendants of Reuben.
verses.15: And the sons of Shem were Yemuel, Yamin, Oahad, Yakhin, Zohar, and Shaul. These were the descendants of Shem.
verses.16: And these are the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, Merari, and two other sons of Levi. There were also seven sons of Levi, and thirty sons in total.
verses.17: To the children of Gershon, to my daughters and my sons, for their families.
verses.18: And the sons of Kehat were Amram, Yizhar, Hoberon, and Uziel. There were also three and thirty people from Kehat’s family.
verses.19: And the children of Merari were diseased and sick; these are the descendants of Levi who were born to their mothers.
verses.20: And Amram took Jochebed as his wife. She gave birth to Aaron and Moses. In addition, Amram also had seven other sons.
verses.21: And the sons of Yizhar became cold and weak. And Zikri also.
verses.22: And the sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.23: And Aaron took Eliseba, the daughter of Jemimah, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife. She gave him birth to Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Itamar.
verses.24: And the sons of Korach, Asir, Elkanah, and Abiasaf – these are the descendants of the people of Korach.
verses.25: And Elazar, son of Aaron, was taken as a wife from the descendants of Puthiel. She gave birth to Pinchas. These were the leaders of the Israelites, for their families.
verses.26: It was Aaron and Moses, who were told by Jehovah to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt on their own feet.
verses.27: They were those who spoke to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, in order to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. Those people were Moses and Aaron.
verses.28: And it happened that one day, Jehovah spoke to Moses on the land of Egypt.
verses.29: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, “I, the LORD, speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, about all that I will say to you.”
verses.30: And Moses said before the LORD, “Behold, I am weak in speech; how then can Pharaoh listen to me?”
